source_refs.note: Topic 7.6.5.1 (PDF 190, printed 187). The printed list numbers its examples as items 2 and 4. Long question 5 is answered; contrast, captions and keyboard use are general knowledge, flagged.

items: Readable fonts: clear, large fonts such as Arial or Times New Roman instead of decorative styles.
Alternative text for images: describe images, charts and graphs so visually impaired users can understand them.
